name: usage-showcase
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this single ClaudeBuddy usage promotional image. Change ONLY the two usage progress-bar fills inside the light and dark interface illustrations from coral/orange to usage green #22c55e, because the displayed 24% reading falls in the product's green 0–60% range. Keep the coral crab/logo, every letter of text, serif typography, dark slate/cream palette, exact composition, sizes, captions, all other icons and all artwork unchanged. One standalone image only, no contact sheet.
